name: neon-text
title: Neon Text — humming sign header
description: A reactive light-DOM web component that renders a two-tier neon sign: a small blinking `dim` line and a large humming `bright` line, with random letters shorting out on an interval. Zero dependencies, self-hosted NeonTubes face (inlined).
tagline: Reactive two-tier neon sign — random tubes short out; themeable tube color.
registration: self-registers via customElements.define('neon-text') — just drop the tag; no bootstrap needed
